decisions.decision: BarChart bar colors are matched to the real map legend (LANDUSE_LEGEND, LAND_COVER_LEGEND) only for agriculture and landscape, not soil or economic.
decisions.rationale: Human verification (checkpoint round 1) found bar colors didn't match the map. Root cause: agriculture/landscape have closed, static, byte-exact legends that are literally what LLMap paints; soil's real legend is built dynamically per-LL via a hash function the static SOIL_LEGEND doesn't reproduce (would be misleading if matched); economic has no category legend at all (continuous price ramp). Fix scoped precisely to the two layers where it's actually correct.

decisions.decision: Other-bucket display pct floored at 0.1 when the true summed remainder is non-zero.
decisions.rationale: Code review (CR-01, confirmed blocker) found Math.round could display a real non-zero remainder as '0%' (reproduced against io-lulc-landcover-east-brandenburg.json's 0.04% Bare-ground row). Fixed to mirror the pipeline's own never-display-a-real-row-as-zero convention.
